2609.40185.title: Provably Tractable NFA-Constrained Language Generation via HMMs
2609.40185.paper_summary: Constrained generation aims to sample from language models (LMs) conditioned on hard constraints. Existing constrained-generation techniques for nondeterministic finite automaton (NFA) constraints either distort the distribution or sacrifice efficiency. Theoretically, this task reduces to counting the length-$n$ sequences accepted by an NFA (#NFA), and the exact #NFA problem is #P-complete. Recent work has shown that #NFA admits a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme (FPRAS). Inspired by this result, we propose NFA-LM, a polynomial-time engine for NFA-constrained generation with theoretical guarantees under mild assumptions. Experiments show that NFA-LM efficiently generates high-quality outputs with theoretically bounded approximation error.
2609.40185.paper_summary_zh: 受限生成旨在從受硬性限制條件的語言模型 (LMs) 中進行抽樣。現有的針對非確定性有限自動機 (NFA) 限制的受限生成技術要麼扭曲分佈，要麼犧牲效率。理論上，這項任務簡化為計算被 NFA 接受的長度為 $n$ 的序列 (#NFA)，而精確的 #NFA 問題是 #P 完全的。最近的研究顯示，#NFA 允許一個完全多項式隨機近似方案 (FPRAS)。受到這一結果的啟發，我們提出了 NFA-LM，一個在溫和假設下具有理論保證的多項式時間 NFA 受限生成引擎。實驗表明，NFA-LM 能高效生成具有理論界限近似誤差的高質量輸出。
2609.40185.author: Jialiang Sun et.al.
